rules.description: Registration and subsequent scholarship application are handled as two distinct processes
rules.condition: When a student registers and then applies for a scholarship scheme
rules.outcome: The processes are segregated into two separate processes
rules.evidence_quote: The Registration and thereafter application for a scholarship scheme by Students will be segregated into two separate processes.

rules.description: An instant verification mechanism for Aadhaar number and bank account details is provided on the portal
rules.condition: When a student accesses the portal to register or apply
rules.outcome: The portal will perform instant verification of Aadhaar number and bank account details
rules.evidence_quote: An instant verification mechanism for Aadhaar Number Bank account details of the students will be enabled on the Portal.

rules.description: Students must use the designated common application forms for each scholarship category
rules.condition: When a student wants to apply for a scholarship
rules.outcome: The student must apply through the common form for pre‑matric scholarships and the separate common form for Post Matric & Merit cum Means based scholarships
rules.evidence_quote: Students need to apply through the common application form for pre-matric scholarship and another common form for Post Matric & Merit cum Means based scholarships.

rules.description: Students are permitted to enter eligibility details only after verification succeeds
rules.condition: After successful verification of Aadhaar and bank details
rules.outcome: Students will be allowed to fill in the details required to establish eligibility for scholarships
rules.evidence_quote: On successful verification, the students will be allowed to fill up their details essential for establishing their eligibility for scholarships.

rules.description: The portal shows a list of scholarship schemes the student qualifies for based on entered information
rules.condition: After the student provides required inputs on the portal
rules.outcome: The portal displays the list of schemes for which the student is eligible to apply, including non‑minority schemes
rules.evidence_quote: The Portal will display a list of schemes for which the student is eligible to apply on the basis of his/her inputs (even non-minority scholarship schemes).

rules.description: Guidelines and frequently asked questions for each scheme are presented to the student
rules.condition: When the portal displays the eligible scheme list
rules.outcome: Detailed guidelines and FAQ on these schemes are also displayed
rules.evidence_quote: Detailed guidelines and FAQ on these schemes will also be displayed.

rules.description: Students are required to review scheme details and FAQs before making a selection
rules.condition: When the student is considering which scheme to apply for
rules.outcome: The student must go through the scheme details and FAQ to make an informed choice
rules.evidence_quote: The students must go through the scheme details and FAQ to make an informed choice.
